description.text:
F_Align 4.6v4.539224

F_Align uses Global Motion Estimation (GME) to calculate a four corner pin so that each frame in one shot will be aligned with the corresponding frame in a second reference shot.

Help->Documentation contains a more detailed description of this plug-in.
